learning_objective: 🎯 Learn to create, format, and manage professional text documents using Word Processors, and master advanced tools like Mail Merge and Styles.

key_vocabulary.definition: Software used to compose, edit, format, and print text documents (e.g., MS Word, LibreOffice Writer).
Changing the appearance of text (font, size, color, alignment) to make it readable and attractive.
A feature that combines a main document with a data source to generate personalized letters in bulk.
A pre-designed document structure that serves as a starting point for a new document.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Word processors replaced typewriters. They allow you to easily edit text, insert images, check spelling/grammar, and save digital copies. Elements of the interface include the Title Bar, Menu Bar, Standard Toolbar, and Formatting Toolbar.

Text formatting involves changing Fonts, applying Bold/Italic/Underline, and aligning text (Left, Right, Center, Justify). Page formatting involves setting Margins, Page Orientation (Portrait vs. Landscape), and adding Headers/Footers.
Tables organize data in Rows and Columns. The intersection is a Cell. You can insert images, draw shapes, and use features like 'Wrap Text' to make the text flow neatly around a picture.

If you want to invite 100 people to a party, you don't type 100 letters! You create one 'Main Document' (the invite) and connect it to a 'Data Source' (an address list). Mail Merge automatically fills in the names and prints 100 customized letters.

fun_activity.title: ✉️ The Birthday Mail Merge
fun_activity.instructions: Write a short 3-line birthday invitation. Leave blanks for `<First_Name>` and `<Gift_Requested>`. Now imagine merging it with a list of your 5 best friends. Computer automatically creates: 'Dear Rahul, please bring a Video Game...' and 'Dear Priya, please bring a Book...'. You just acted like a Mail Merge algorithm!

exam_tips: 📌 Know the difference between 'Save' (updates the current file) and 'Save As' (creates a new copy of the file with a new name/location).
📌 Mail Merge requires two components: Main Document and Data Source. This is a guaranteed 2-mark question.
📌 Alignment refers to how text lines up relative to the margins. 'Justify' alignment makes both left and right edges perfectly straight.
quick_recap: ⭐ Portrait orientation is taller than it is wide; Landscape orientation is wider than it is tall.
⭐ The Find and Replace tool allows you to instantly correct a specific misspelled word throughout a 100-page document.
⭐ Headers appear at the top margin of every page, while Footers appear at the bottom (useful for page numbers).
